title: Ada and the Spire
premise: Wendell Voss, a beast-speaker in a valley where magic cannot follow, is dragged from hiding when the crown's hunt for the gifted reaches even his remote home. Guided by a fugitive archivist named Ada, he travels to the capital's ancient Spire, where a parasitic spirit has worn the king like a crown for a generation. Wendell learns the spirit is an inherited power passed down the royal bloodline, and that his own gift descends from the same source, making him the only one who can unbind the king. In the end, Wendell severs the inheritance at terrible cost, the valley's protection breaks forever, and he and his found family must build a world where gifts are neither hunted nor hoarded.
about_author: Oscar Nakamura is the pen name of a former field biologist who spent a decade recording birdsong in remote mountain valleys before turning to fantasy. They write stories about outsiders who can hear what the world is trying to say.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Wendell quietly speaks with the valley's animals, hiding a gift that magic cannot touch here, until a wounded royal courier staggers in carrying a proclamation: all gifted persons must surrender for 'culling.' The animals beg him to flee. Emotional beat: the fragile peace he built shatters; invisibility is revealed as an illusion.

chapters.title: Ada at the Gate
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. A stranger named Ada arrives hunting the courier, claiming to be an archivist who serves the crown. Wendell's beasts expose her lie; she is a fugitive who stole records proving the king is not the king. She offers him escape in exchange for his gift. Emotional beat: wary alliance born of mutual blackmail and need.

chapters.title: What the Wolves Remember
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Fleeing through the pass, Wendell questions wolves who once roamed the capital and learn the Spire 'sings wrong.' Ada reveals the inheritance: a spirit passed crown to crown, devouring each wearer. Wendell realizes his gift shares its root. Emotional beat: dread as he learns he is kin to the monster he must face.

chapters.title: The Road of Small Kindnesses
chapters.summary: Alternating Wendell and Ada POV. The pair shelters with a hidden community of gifted outcasts, a found family in embryo. Wendell heals a dying mule and is seen; Ada teaches him to shield his mind. A hunter's patrol burns the settlement behind them. Emotional beat: warmth discovered, then grief and guilt for the cost of being seen.

chapters.title: The City of Bells
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. They enter the capital disguised as a beast-trainer and his handler. Ada navigates old contacts in the archive while Wendell hears the city's animals whisper of disappearances. They learn the culling feeds the Spire. Emotional beat: claustrophobia and moral vertigo, Wendell's gift becoming both weapon and liability.

chapters.title: The King in the Garden
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Wendell is summoned to tend the royal menagerie, a trap or a chance, and meets the king alone: a hollowed man who briefly surfaces and begs, 'Find my daughter.' Wendell realizes the spirit fears an heir it could not fully consume. Emotional beat: compassion for the enemy; the mission becomes personal.

chapters.title: Ada's Inheritance
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Ada confesses she is the king's hidden daughter, the heir the spirit hunts, and stole the archives to unmake the inheritance that murdered her mother. Wendell's fury and loyalty collide. The spirit, through the king, offers Wendell power if he delivers her. Emotional beat: betrayal, then forgiveness; the found family tested and holding.

chapters.title: The Hunt Closes
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. The Spire's hunters corner them in the archive's depths; the outcasts from the road arrive to fight as their chosen family. Ada is captured and dragged to the Spire for the spirit's next inheritance. Emotional beat: sacrifice and resolve, Wendell choosing to walk into the trap willingly.

chapters.title: The Spire Sings
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Climax. Inside the Spire, Wendell speaks with the spirit in the tongue of beasts and learns it was once a guardian animal bound into service, corrupted by generations of stolen power. He offers it release instead of destruction while Ada, on the throne dais, claims and renounces her inheritance, breaking the line. Emotional beat: terror transfigured into mercy.

chapters.title: Where the Magic Follows
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. The king dies free, the spirit dissolves into the wind, and Ada refuses the crown, helping found a council where the gifted are citizens, not resources. The valley's protection is gone, but Wendell no longer needs hiding. He returns home with his found family. Emotional beat: grief braided with hope; inheritance remade as choice, not burden.
